goal: Retire OpenClaw, Qclaw, and JWClaw as runtime systems so DC-Agent has no executable dependency on their processes, schedulers, dashboards, probes, or repair actions.

acceptance_criteria.description: DC-Agent no longer ships the OpenClaw on-demand plugin or exposes an OpenClaw system entry.
The watchdog and repair controller no longer probe, schedule, or restart OpenClaw.
acceptance_criteria.verification: uv run pytest tests/test_legacy_claw_retirement.py tests/test_task_control_plane.py tests/test_watchdog_repair.py -q

acceptance_criteria.description: Operator restart and verification scripts no longer treat OpenClaw as a DC-Agent service.
